text:
matt: Heads-up — Q3 capacity sprint: forecasts show a ~35% spike in inference hours for the EMEA marketing campaign. Need plan for H100/H200/L40S allocation and fallback. Anyone with lead-time numbers?

ana: We should prioritize H200 for latency-sensitive paths, but H200 lead time is ~12–16 weeks if we commit now. H100 is more available (6–9w) and cheaper per unit for throughput.

jia: Quick numbers from my model run: converting 10k GPU-hours from H100->H200 reduces p95 by ~30% but increases cost ~22%. Tradeoff depends on SLAs.

oliver: What's the regional constraint? APAC has limited H200 stock right now. EMEA has more H200 but customs lead time is variable. We should consider cross-region failover.

sre-bot: incident: compute-queue-eu1 saw transient spikes last night; recommend soft limits on low-priority workloads to protect latency SLOs. :rotating_light:

matt: Proposal: reserve a small H200 pool for critical routes (canary + prod), use H100 for background/batch, and L40S for embeddings and cheap jobs. Also set an automatic fallback routing policy if regional capacity drops below 70%.

procurement: Current vendor ETA for H200 racks to eu-west is 14 weeks if PO submitted this week. We can do a partial shipment (20% earlier) but cost goes up ~8%.

ana: If we commit to H200, we should gate with canary rollouts and autoscale thresholds. Suggest config snippet for routing policy: 

```yaml
routing: 
  - match: route:prod-low-latency
    prefer: H200
    fallback: H100, L40S
    threshold: 0.7 # region capacity fraction
  - match: route:batch
    prefer: H100
    fallback: L40S
```

jia: Also recommend reserving KV-cache memory configs for H200 instances to reduce token compute for hot prefixes — can halve cost for chat routes in tests.

oliver: Risk matrix I see:
- Customs delays (EU) -> increases lead time by 2–6 weeks
- APAC stock short -> need cross-region routing or dedicated capacity
- Budget overrun if we over-commit H200 for non-critical paths

matt: Action items: 
1) procurement to get partial PO for 20% H200 (procurement) — due EOD Fri.
2) infra to add routing policy + fallback in staging for canary (ana/jia) — due Tue.
3) SRE to enforce soft limits on low-priority queues (oliver) — do this asap.

procurement: Confirming — I'll push PO for a 20% partial shipment and request firm ETA windows. Will update this thread with order number.

ana: I'll draft the canary routing PR. Will include telemetry flags to measure p95 and cost delta.

matt: Thanks. If we get the partial H200 earlier, we'll shift a small subset of prod traffic next sprint. If not, fallback rules kick in and we rely on H100 + caching. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job: soft-limit rollout to non-prod queues at 2026-04-12T03:00Z

jia: FYI I ran a quick sim — with fallback routing enabled, p95 stays within SLO 92% of the time, cost increases ~6% in worst-case. I'll attach detailed sim in the doc tracker.

oliver: Noted. I'll also run a quick network egress load check for cross-region failover and report any bandwidth bottlenecks.

matt: Cool. We'll sync on Wednesday standup if procurement has PO and infra has the PR. Good thread. :wave:
